deviations_from_card: One commit instead of two (allowed by the brief). package.json not changed: slot A's test:unit glob already picks up the new test file. Added JOURNEY_AUDIO_DIR so the CLI cases (3, 7) run narrate.mjs in a temp dir, never take/. Beyond the card: a failed re-voice also drops that beat's durations.json length (so the recorder estimates it instead of pacing to the old line's clip), a dry run leaves a real manifest untouched, and the budget guard runs twice (offline plan before any request, then on the library's real cast). Lines changed (~863 incl. 257 test + 51 ADR) is slightly past the ~800 guide, mostly tests.
notes: Red-before is module-absent for all 8 (the whole file fails to import); the old narrate.mjs was not run against the CLI cases because it ignores JOURNEY_AUDIO_DIR and would write into take/. Guard cases 2/5/6/7 are red only because the module was absent. The --dry gate wrote take/audio/{durations,manifest}.json (gitignored), and they were removed afterwards; take/ was empty before. Needs a live run: a real ElevenLabs synthesis + ffprobe pass (manifest sha writing, phase-2 recast from the library's auto-pick, failure path exit 5). Sibling modified files left unstaged (apps/desktop/src/companion/model.ts, examples/demo-kit/package.json, voice scene files).
